command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/go-eye-runtime-v4.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch chatgpt-work/avatar-eye-identity-canonical-mask-20260912 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity.git "$TMP/repo"
DIR="$TMP/repo/research_entity/avatar_eye_identity"
HEAD=$(git -C "$TMP/repo" rev-parse HEAD); echo BRANCH_HEAD=$HEAD
python3 -m py_compile "$DIR/validate_shadow_blink_runtime_v4.py"
OUT="$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_shadow_runtime_v4_20260912_0925"
SHADOW="$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_semantic_shadow5/buehne.shadow.html"
BEFORE=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
set +e
python3 "$DIR/validate_shadow_blink_runtime_v4.py" --visual-root "$ROOT" --shadow "$SHADOW" --out "$OUT" --http-port 9290 --cdp-port 9291 | tee "$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_shadow_runtime_v4_20260912_0925.stdout.json"
RC=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
set -e
AFTER=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
test "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER"
if test -f "$OUT/report.json"; then cat "$OUT/report.json"; fi
echo VALIDATOR_RC=$RC
echo LIVE_SHA=$AFTER
echo SCOPE=REAL_BROWSER_EXACT_SHADOW_RUNTIME_V4_REPORTABLE_NO_LIVE_WRITE
exit $RC
